shopSettings.about: Every piece in my showroom ranges from antique & vintage household items to ecclectic collectors pieces and everything in-between. Check back for new finds and follow along for updates on inventory @willgantiquity and eBay links found below.
shopSettings.location: Abington, PA — Local Pickup (Inquire for location)

journalItems.text: Save and provide quality antiques for customers seeking to purchase a piece of history and art of their own.
Authentically collecting & cleaning up pieces using various techniques without ruining the patina. Pieces in the showroom will show a Restored badge showing which item was restored and how.
Pricing is based off of recently sold listings and local/online market prices. I believe in offers so fair offers and bundle deals are considered!
Initial pictures of items will NOT be enhanced by AI in anyway with the exception of the last picture in the carousel showing a staging use concept if needed.

customTexts.statLabel3: Reliable Pick up schedualing and online store shipping
customTexts.contactCardHeading: Contact Me or Send an Inquiry
customTexts.inquiryLead: Select one or more pieces below to generate a pre-formatted purchase request via email or copyable text/DM message.
customTexts.step1Desc: Explore our current showroom inventory. Click any item to review pictures, era, restoration notes, and other special details.
customTexts.step2Desc: Select your item in the inquiry form below (or click "Inquire to Purchase" on any card). Let me know if you'd like to request a local pickup or visit my ebay link for "eBay" badged items to browse and purchase shippable items.
customTexts.step3Desc: I'll confirm availability and send a total. Pay easily via Venmo Business or Cash and coordinate pickup.
customTexts.ethosLead: Part of what I do is offer  a service to help go through and assess items (Ex: A loved ones home items or assets left behind) and help sell or give direction on ways to make money for clients and their families. There are no upfront costs! Profits for each item sold is split 50/50 after platform fees and taxes.
customTexts.ethosCard1Desc: When beneficial, a good cleaning with mineral spirits, ultra sonic bath, and or delicate paint stripping apply
customTexts.ethosCard2Desc: Mortise locks, Architectual Salvage, lamps, etc are all inspected, rewired or lubricated on most pieces. Vintage electronics are verified working before being listed unless specified otherwise
customTexts.ethosCard3Desc: I like to preserve original warm age patina and style while protecting surfaces for decades to come—using hand applied clear wax, linseed oils, and appropriate oil based rust preventatives.
